hypothesis: Coins that have survived several years inside the low-cap band without dying have demonstrated something - real users, real maintenance, real exchange relationships - that no free fundamental dataset provides. Conditioning on years-survived-in-band is therefore a quality proxy obtainable from the point-in-time panel alone, and it is unavailable to large capital for the same capacity reason as H1. Turnover is the lowest of the four because survivors persist by definition.
notes: Deliberately allocated the smallest budget because of the H2 overlap.
Survival duration is measured in the panel only; it is left-censored at 2017-08-17 and coins alive at the window start are marked censored, not assigned an age.
refutation: REFUTED if forward returns are unrelated to survival duration after controlling for market cap and venue liquidity, or if the relation is negative - old low-caps dying slowly rather than proving quality. ALSO REFUTED, as a distinct hypothesis, if survival duration adds nothing to the H2 death screen: if the two are the same effect measured twice, this one has no independent content and will be reported as subsumed rather than as a second confirmation.

benchmark: equal-weight buy-and-hold of the same point-in-time universe
selection_criterion.construction: equal-weight within survival-duration cohort, annual rebalance
selection_criterion.costs: docs/CRYPTO_LOWCAP_COST_MODEL.md measured model, p75 quantile, $1,000 order size, non-executable books = no trade

also_reported: DSR with observed variance, new ledger only
DSR with the 109-trial ETF ledger combined (N=124)
deflated_sharpe.n_trials_policy: the DECLARED budget is used even if fewer are spent
deflated_sharpe.sharpe_variance_floor_source: cross-trial variance of the 109-trial ETF ledger
deflated_sharpe.variance_policy: max(observed across this experiment's trials, floor)

selection_criterion.power_limitation_declared: a 2.69-year holdout has a standard error of roughly 0.75 on an annualized Sharpe, so it cannot separate a true Sharpe of 1.0 from 0; the verdict is a range, not a point, and will be reported as one
selection_criterion.validation: walk-forward with embargo, same methodology as the ETF study

universe: membership: point-in-time CMC snapshot at each date, cmc_id identity
screen: cmc_rank <= 1000 on the rebalance date
tradability: venue klines required on the rebalance date (bybit or binance spot USDT)
prices: venue klines only; snapshot prices are cross-check, never execution
excluded: stablecoins (declared filter), coins with no vetted-venue listing
